sections.bias: Potential sources of selection, measurement, and analysis bias will be addressed through consistent eligibility criteria, predefined assessments, and the approved analysis plan.
sections.consent: Written informed consent will be obtained before any study-specific prospective procedure. The consent discussion and signed form will be documented in the study records.
sections.unscheduled: An unscheduled contact may occur when an additional study-related assessment is needed. The reason for the contact, assessments performed, and resulting actions will be documented in the study records.
sections.discontinued-subjects: A participant may stop taking part at any time. Information collected before withdrawal may remain in the study records and may be included in the analysis as permitted by the consent and applicable requirements.
sections.discontinuation: A participant may discontinue participation at any time without penalty or loss of benefits to which the participant is otherwise entitled. The study team may document the reason when the participant chooses to provide one, and information collected before withdrawal may continue to be used as permitted by the consent and applicable requirements.
sections.publication: Study results may be presented or published only in a form that protects participant confidentiality and follows the approved publication and data-governance requirements.
sections.safety-general: An adverse event is an unfavorable medical occurrence reported during study participation, whether or not it is considered related to a study activity. A serious adverse event is an event that results in death, is life-threatening, requires or prolongs inpatient hospitalization, causes persistent or significant disability, or is an important medical event. A device quality complaint is a reported concern about the identity, quality, durability, reliability, safety, effectiveness, or performance of the study device.
sections.safety-monitoring: From consent through the final scheduled study contact, study personnel will ask about relevant health changes and concerns that may be related to study activities or the study device. Reported information will be documented with the available onset, seriousness, severity, relationship, action, and outcome information.
sections.safety-reporting: The investigator will review reported events for seriousness and possible relationship to study activities or the study device. Serious events and device quality complaints will be communicated to the sponsor and reviewing ethics committee within the timelines required by the applicable approved procedures and governing requirements.
sections.safety-followup: Reported safety events and device quality complaints will be followed until resolution, stabilization, or a documented determination that further follow-up is not clinically meaningful, to the extent follow-up is permitted after withdrawal.
sections.safety-analysis: Safety findings will be summarized descriptively using the event categories, seriousness, severity, relationship, timing, action, and outcome information available in the study data. No inferential safety analysis is planned.
sections.ethics: The study will be conducted under the approved protocol, applicable institutional review board requirements, and applicable ethical and privacy protections.
sections.ethics-confidentiality: The study will be conducted under the approved protocol, applicable institutional review board requirements, and applicable ethical and privacy protections. Study records will use appropriate identifiers and access controls. Identifiable information will be available only to authorized personnel and oversight bodies as permitted by the approved protocol and applicable law.
sections.confidentiality-cross-reference: Confidentiality protections for study records and participant information are described in Section 16.
sections.confidentiality: Study records will use appropriate identifiers and access controls. Identifiable information will be available only to authorized personnel and oversight bodies as permitted by the approved protocol and applicable law.
sections.injury: If you believe that a study activity caused an injury or medical problem, contact the study doctor promptly using the contact information in this form. Seek emergency care when needed. The study team will explain available care and any responsibility for related costs. Signing this form does not waive your legal rights.
sections.completion: Participant completion requires fulfillment of the approved participant-completion criteria. Discontinuation is a distinct participant disposition, not completion; closeout documentation does not change that disposition.
sections.study-completion: Study completion follows the approved study-completion criteria and applicable closeout requirements. Participant completion and discontinuation remain distinct dispositions in the study records.
sections.termination: The investigator may end an individual participant's study participation when continued participation is unsafe, eligibility is no longer met, required follow-up cannot be completed, or the approved protocol otherwise requires termination.
sections.study-termination: Study termination follows the decision-making authority and grounds specified in the approved study-termination provisions. Applicable notification and closeout requirements remain in effect; closeout does not confer additional termination authority.
sections.retrospective-bias: Bias will be limited through predefined record-selection criteria, consistent abstraction methods, prespecified variables, and the approved analysis plan.
sections.retrospective-consent: This retrospective study uses existing records. Any consent or authorization waiver will be determined by the reviewing institutional review board before records are accessed for research.
sections.retrospective-confidentiality: Only the approved existing-record data will be abstracted. Direct identifiers will be handled under the approved privacy plan, and reports will not identify individual patients.
sections.retrospective-safety: The study does not assign an intervention. Safety information will be abstracted only when it is part of the approved data set; no new clinical safety procedure is introduced by the record review.
sections.costs: Before you sign this form, the study team will explain whether any costs are associated with the research activities and which costs, if any, are your responsibility.
sections.alternatives: Participation is voluntary. You may choose not to participate and may discuss available care options with your treating clinician.
sections.protocol-sparse-risks: Participation may involve inconvenience or discomfort associated with the study procedures described in this protocol, as well as a risk of loss of confidentiality. The safeguards described in the protocol will be used to reduce these risks.
sections.protocol-sparse-benefits: Participants may receive no direct benefit from taking part. Knowledge gained from the study may contribute to a better understanding of the condition, intervention, or procedures being evaluated.
sections.icf-sparse-risks: Taking part may involve inconvenience or discomfort from the study procedures described in this consent form. There is also a risk that private information could be disclosed, although safeguards will be used to protect it.
sections.icf-sparse-benefits: You may receive no direct benefit from taking part in this study. Information learned from the study may help researchers better understand the condition, intervention, or procedures being evaluated.
sections.investigator-agreement-prospective: I confirm that I have read and understand this protocol. I agree to conduct the study in accordance with the approved protocol and to protect the rights, safety, privacy, and well-being of study participants.
sections.investigator-agreement-retrospective: I confirm that I have read and understand this protocol. I agree to conduct the retrospective review in accordance with the approved protocol and to protect the rights, safety, and privacy of people whose records are included.
sections.investigator-principle-ethics: Applicable ethical principles and the Declaration of Helsinki.
sections.investigator-principle-law: Applicable laws, privacy requirements, and institutional policies.
sections.investigator-principle-protocol: The approved protocol and applicable reporting obligations.
sections.icf-introduction: You are being invited to take part in a research study. Taking part is voluntary. Please read this form carefully and ask any questions you may have before deciding whether to participate. If you decide to participate, you will be asked to sign and date this form and will receive a copy.
sections.icf-ambispective-disclosure: This study will use information already recorded before you join and will also collect information during future study activities described in this form.
sections.icf-voluntary: Taking part is voluntary. You may refuse to participate or leave the study at any time without penalty or loss of benefits to which you are otherwise entitled.
sections.icf-new-findings: The study team will tell you about significant new information that may affect your willingness to continue in the study.
sections.icf-leaving: You may stop participating at any time. Tell the study doctor if you decide to leave so the study team can explain any final steps needed for your safety and records.
sections.icf-privacy-authorization: By signing this form, you authorize the study team to collect, use, and disclose the medical and study information described in this form for this research, including information from existing records when applicable and information collected during future study activities. Records will use appropriate identifiers and access controls. Authorized representatives of the sponsor, reviewing ethics committee, and regulatory authorities may review this information as permitted by applicable requirements. Reports and publications will not identify you.
sections.icf-withdrawal: Taking part is voluntary. You may refuse to participate or leave the study at any time without penalty or loss of benefits to which you are otherwise entitled. Tell the study doctor or study staff if you decide to leave. After your withdrawal takes effect, no new routine research procedures will be performed unless you separately agree to them. Information collected before withdrawal may continue to be used as permitted by this consent and applicable requirements.
sections.icf-consent-statement: By signing below, you confirm that you have read this form, had the opportunity to ask questions, received satisfactory answers, voluntarily agree to participate, and authorize the collection, use, and disclosure described above.
sections.icf-no-sign: If you do not agree with the statement above, you should not sign this informed consent document.
